mapper.insert: insert into biz_survey_notify (user_id, survey_id, answer_id, title, content, read_flag, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{surveyId}, #{answerId}, #{title}, #{content}, '0', now())
mapper.select: select n.notify_id, n.user_id, n.survey_id, n.answer_id, n.title, n.content, n.read_flag, n.create_time, s.survey_name from biz_survey_notify n left join biz_survey s on s.survey_id = n.survey_id where n.user_id = #{userId} order by n.notify_id desc limit #{limit}
select count(1) from biz_survey_notify where user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update biz_survey_notify set read_flag = '1' where notify_id = #{notifyId} and user_id = #{userId}
update biz_survey_notify set read_flag = '1' where user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0'
